app.notes: Host Setup: picking up a setup now always remembers where you were, even after a restart or an update. Continue on the home screen takes you straight back, and a finished setup opens on its finished page with nothing to type. Monitor/Vote: a node whose wallet is on this computer shows as yours by itself, so you can vote without linking it first. Every panel on your node's page has a button to close it, and connecting to your server offers the SSH key GNOT created. The app also runs on the latest Electron security fixes.
